originalAlarm.description: Memory dynamically allocated by `malloc` on line 10 is not freed after the last access at line 12, column 5.

model:
(define-fun SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto () Bool
  false)
(define-fun HAVE_ECC () Bool
  true)
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (KNOWN, OVER-CONSTRAINED): When HAVE_ECC=true, eckey is malloc'd at line 10 and the function returns without freeing it — genuine memory leak. KNOWN BUG: The vbdb entry for 35ae2e259e4.c documents exactly this MemoryLeak when HAVE_ECC=true. OVER-CONSTRAINED: The presence condition requires SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto=false. However, when HAVE_ECC=true and SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto=true, the #if defined(SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto) branch only does '// do something' (a no-op), and eckey is still never freed. The memory leak exists for any value of SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto when HAVE_ECC=true. The condition unnecessarily excludes SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto=true, making it over-constrained.
